slides.title: Q3 FY26 board update for Northwind Logistics
slides.subtitle: Board of directors, October 2026

slides.title: Q3 beat plan on revenue and margin; SMB churn needs a EUR 1.2M fix

points.lead: Revenue and margin are ahead of plan.
points.support: Revenue reached EUR 48.2M, up 12% year on year, at a 14.1% EBITDA margin against a 13% plan.
On-time delivery was 96.4% in the quarter.

points.lead: SMB churn is the one real risk.
points.support: Quarterly SMB churn rose from 2.2% to 3.1%.

points.lead: A dedicated success team is the best fix.
points.support: It costs EUR 1.2M, half the price of a self-serve portal, and can be live by Q2 FY27.

slides.bottom_line: Approve EUR 1.2M and eight hires for an SMB success team.
